streaming.boundsSpace: original Z-up world before existing world X=-pi/2 transform

transportNotes.runtimeCompaction: Not needed; loader sets geometry.userData.compacted=true and child mesh.scale=positionScale. Existing compactMesh then becomes a no-op.
transportNotes.grassFieldScale: Existing materials, UV bytes and metadata preserved.
transportNotes.bounds: boundsZUp retains original source bounds for spatial selection; decodedBoundsZUp measures scaled quantized positions.
transportNotes.sourceProvenance: Original sourceExpandedSha256 and any LOD source/candidate fields retained. Far may already be lossy LOD.
transportNotes.equivalence: Attribute arrays must equal current compact-geometry.js result; this is not lossless original geometry.
